_comment: Pure data. Editing this file changes which seats routing can pick and how
a project maps to a direction; it never requires a code change.
tiers are ordered strongest first. `base` is the untagged name-convention
seat (base + direction, e.g. 孙悟空 + 游戏 = 孙悟空游戏). A tier whose seat
does not exist in the workspace is skipped at candidate-build time rather
`seats` is every routable base on that rung. `provider` is the model family
(openai, anthropic, deepseek, xai, google), so a same-tier handoff can tell
a GPT seat from any other house. A direction seat is not listed; it inherits
its base's provider. `model` and `thinking` are the live workspace seat
config this ladder was aligned to — not a guess from an older comment.
孙悟饭 (gpt-6-astra) is strongest, 特兰克斯 (gpt-6-sol) is strong, 克林
(gpt-6-luna) is weak; all three are openai. 贝吉塔 and 比克 are different
rungs on purpose: their model strings are different command-code accounts
of deepseek-v4.1-flash, and thinking differs (贝吉塔 high → medium, 比克
low → weak). 孙悟天 (grok-4.7, xai) shares strong; 人造人18号
_fallback_comment: The rung an unconfident verdict lands on. Routing never leaves the
executor slot empty: a ticket nobody picked up is invisible, while a seat
picked one rung off is visible and one click to change.
_projects_comment: project name -> direction. These rows are only the DEFAULTS shipped with
the binary. A workspace's own rows live in workspace.settings.routing.projects,
win over these, and are edited with `multica workspace routing-projects`
— no release. A key may be exact or a `prefix*`; a value is one of
`directions`, or 通用 for a project that is deliberately general-purpose.
A project absent from both tables, or an issue with no project at all,
routes to the generic (undirected) rung of the ladder; the decision comment
says the direction is unknown rather than guessing one.
